project.name: SITE MSM
project.scope: All existing pages; shared brand DNA with unique editorial compositions per page
project.reference_policy: Conceptual visual references only. Never treat generated imagery, numbers, example names, locations or copy as corporate facts.

creative_north_star.statement: Engenharia em escala humana, capacidade operacional real e precisão tecnológica, expressas com composição editorial cinematográfica, máxima clareza e discrição sofisticada.

reference_dna.name: Concept references generated for MSM direction
extract: cinematic mine panoramas at natural warm light
reference_dna.warning: Fictional visuals and statistics; use for design principles only.

creative_north_star.anti_template_rule: Do not repeat the same hero, bento grid, overlay or card shape across every route. Distinct art direction, shared design system.

brand.palette_note: All colors except MSM Blue are preliminary design candidates, to be measured for WCAG contrast and validated against official logos and existing material.

color_usage.primary: institutional links, focus brand elements, selected backgrounds
color_usage.dark: cinematic overlays, premium navigation contexts, high-impact sections
color_usage.light: editorial reading areas, statistics, governance and forms
color_usage.accent: restrained operations-inspired CTA or thin separators; never dominate MSM Blue

assets.logos: official repository logos only; never redraw
assets.photography: verified original company image library only for implemented website
assets.conceptual_mocks: image references for composition, not factual or deployable company assets

layout.strategy: photographic editorial composition plus rigorous responsive grid
layout.vertical_rhythm: Large cinematic compositions alternated with precise, quiet reading surfaces

hero_height.mobile: content-aware; avoid clipping; height not rigid

typography.direction: Contemporary editorial industrial; ownable, confident, highly readable
typography.headline: Strong sans display with selective alternate weights; avoid automatically using monospaced typography for every headline
typography.body: Readable editorial sans or restrained serif pairing if empirically validated
typography.rule: Prefer currently licensed/installed fonts; validate load performance, Portuguese diacritics and brand coherence.
typography.max_line_length: Avoid full-width paragraphs; mobile headings with natural breaks
typography.metrics: Editorial numerals with consistent units and verified source

navigation.desktop: refined floating capsule OR understated overlay depending on page photography, not repeated blindly
navigation.mobile: accessible compact bar and menu, focus trapped when modal, ESC closes, clear touch targets
navigation.sticky: only after visual and interaction testing; never block underlying clicks
navigation.logo: official brand art with supporting plate only if needed for contrast

photography.priority: Real MSM / Pedra Norte / Grupo Soster operations, workers, equipment and infrastructure
photography.hero_crop: Choose per viewport with focal point; no mandatory centered crop
photography.overlay: local gradient or scrim behind text only as needed for measured contrast
photography.image_quality: preserve resolution, use next/image, responsive sizes, avoid stretched assets
photography.human_presence: use only authentic approved organizational photography
photography.media_card: optional, unique to contextual page; no generic floating card on every route

motion.reduced_motion: Disable autoplay and nonessential motion when prefers-reduced-motion is active
motion.never: scroll hijacking, mandatory parallax, motion hiding content

components.rule: Components should support compositional variety; avoid over-abstracting designs into uniform cards.

home.hero: A compelling real operational photo occupying most of first view, strong headline and sparse CTA; photo remains visible
home.layout_signature: cinematic full-bleed to bright verified metrics to asymmetric service narrative

sobre.hero: Large editorial portrait of actual operation, leadership or landscape with typographic authority
sobre.layout_signature: alternating timeline-like story and photographic statements; only if chronology is sourced

servicos.hero: Precise service photography and assertive technical title
servicos.layout_signature: alternating service feature sections with content-specific media
avoid: generic four-card grid on every breakpoint

atuacoes.hero: Dramatic true operation relevant to the page
atuacoes.layout_signature: large landscape photo essays with sectional technical annotations

estrutura.hero: Photographic panorama of genuine operational facilities and equipment
estrutura.layout_signature: immersive gallery with clean technical inventory-style compositions

obras.hero: Featured documented project photo with editorial overlay
obras.layout_signature: case-study index with distinct project narratives and filter only if justified

integridade.layout_signature: light reading surface plus strong typographic sections and accessible disclosures

codigo_de_etica.layout_signature: document-first layout with reading navigation and correct semantics

contato.hero: Concise premium composition with authentic location/operations visual
contato.layout_signature: balanced editorial information and actionable contact controls
signature_elements: map only if existing validated integration

environment.note: Paths are user-provided project context; confirm actual paths in runtime before use.

restrictions: No push, deploy, merge, rebase or force-push
Do not modify master, production, database, domain or third-party integrations
Preserve original copy, routes, contact information, metadata, robots and sitemap
Do not use generated reference image as an authentic asset
No visual approval claimed without owner review
implementation_contract.execution_model: Claude-first Harness Engineering: inventory -> visual matrix -> implement -> render -> screenshot -> inspect -> refine -> tests -> separate-subagent review -> human approval
implementation_contract.approval_gate: Owner approves home creative direction before large-scale internal-page rollout; per-page individual composition can then be implemented.

required_per_page: verify correct worktree and fresh CSS
console errors and failed network requests
prohibited_claims: Axe zero violations equals perfect design

quality_gates.visual_rubric_note: Heuristic evaluation only; cannot be converted automatically into owner approval.

traceability.reference_image_policy: All reference images in this conversation depict third-party inspiration or fictional generated mockups; their copy and metrics are not MSM facts.
traceability.verified_from_report: Site MSM project diagnostics and implementation state were reported by Claude in prior conversation, not independently inspected here.
